en: A barrier of light blocks the way. Its switch must be under guard.
The Lift Key! The grunt beside it won't let anyone near it.
So. You've come all the way down here. I'm impressed that a child could find our hideout at all.
Team Rocket captures Pokémon from around the world. They're tools for making us rich, nothing more.
And you, child, are in my way. I'm Giovanni, and I'll teach you the price of meddling!
What?! This can't be! You've put me in my place, I see.
I'll leave this hideout to you. But remember: Team Rocket isn't finished. We'll meet again!
A strange scope on Giovanni's desk. Not with him standing right there!
